title: Hylton Planetarium — Service Modernization
goal: Increase program reach and operational clarity for educators, parents, and patrons.
summary: Service design + brand refresh + booking-friendly IA for a county planetarium serving educators and the public.

sections.title: Approach
sections.body: Service design across educator/patron journeys; task-first IA (Programs, Booking, Educator Resources, Community Events); accessible component library; scheduling flow.

sections.title: What I Led
sections.body:
• Intake/pricing/scope; staffing and vendor management.
• Stakeholder sessions; research plan; heuristic evaluation.
• Supervised low→high fidelity design and final website delivery; brand guidelines; photography oversight.
• QA and content; ensured WCAG/508 compliance.

sections.title: Outcomes
sections.body: Higher program discoverability, faster booking decisions, consistent brand across print and digital.
